ai.title: Agent runtime refuses truncated tool calls and cut-off file rewrites
ai.summary: The agent runtime now guards against two failure modes where a model response is cut off mid-generation: incomplete tool call arguments and `write_file` calls that replace a file with a much shorter, bracket-unbalanced copy. In `tool-executor.ts`, `isTruncatedJsonPrefix` detects arguments that never closed, and the error message tells the model nothing was written, explicitly refusing to echo the partial input back to prevent the model from re-sending the same oversized call. In `process-file-block.ts`, `detectTruncatedRewrite` refuses a `write_file` if the new content is under 60% of the original length (for files with 30+ lines) and leaves brackets open, preventing files from being truncated on disk. These refusals are logged to Axiom via the new `FILE_WRITE_GUARD_EVENT` for operational monitoring.
